requirements.title: Complete preparation entry and explicit stage resume
requirements.rule: connect the local Prepare form and idempotent Generate action to canonical text, mutations/key and stored audio through their existing native owners; preserve optional controls and independent native scoring

requirements.title: Foreground interruption and saved recovery
requirements.rule: retain saved checkpoints/receipts on deadline, cancellation, dependency or model failure, expose explicit Resume with frozen settings, and never dispatch inference on readback or completed action replay

requirements.title: Consistent complete private backup
requirements.rule: quiesce actual writers and export the complete native database/private media/source/evidence/model/optional-Lab snapshot with actual file inventory; exclude credentials and publish only a complete archive

requirements.title: Single admission and fresh restore
requirements.rule: admit an external backup once, reject unsafe/incomplete/tampered/incompatible inputs, restore accepted bytes into fresh volumes only and report missing provider credentials without inference

requirements.title: Explicit reversible workspace switch
requirements.rule: switch only explicitly to a ready restored workspace, retain the previous workspace, recover it on switch failure and remember the actual selected project

requirements.title: Reference-aware cleanup and deletion
requirements.rule: preview and explicitly apply reference-aware native erasure with exact selected IDs, shared-object retention, active/stale-plan guards, retryable media cleanup and truthful copied-Lab disposition

requirements.title: Local navigation and actionable failures
requirements.rule: make all existing local features reachable and errors actionable, preserve user inputs and saved work, expose progress/Resume and concrete Docker-only recovery instructions

requirements.title: Full native recovery and usability evidence
requirements.rule: observe positive and negative native/browser restart, backup, restore, switch, persistence and recovery scenarios with independent literal expectations and explicit substitution boundaries

inference: Coordination reuses native frozen stages. Controlled native responses prove coordination only; unchanged accepted stage quality evidence retained. New prompt/model semantics require actual local Lab evidence.
